title: Beatable Adventure
description: Want to beat Minecraft in the Adventure mode? This datapack can do it possible!
body:
Beatable Adventure

Datapack for the Minecraft

Want to beat Minecraft in the Adventure mode? This datapack can do it possible!

### Features * Crafted **Diamond Pickaxe** can break **Obsidian** * Crafted **Flint and Steel** can be used on **Obsidian** * Broken **Obsidian** can be placed to any **Obsidian** * Crafted **Eye of Ender** can be placed to the **Ender Portal Frame** ### Versions * 1.21.11 *Other versions will be later* ----- [@CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 License](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/4.0) **Get on: [@Github](https://github.com/ami-amai/beatable-adventure-datapack) [@Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/datapack/beatable-adventure-datapack) [@CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/beatable-adventure-datapack)**
